referenceSources.title: Iconic Auctioneers | 1994 Ford Escort RS Cosworth -For Sale
referenceSources.description:
A Mallard Green 1994 Ford Escort RS Cosworth is presented from the rear, highlighting its distinctive high-mounted spoiler, wide body panels, and single exhaust outlet. The right-hand drive rally homologation special wears the cherished registration K11 CSY on a bright yellow plate. Its clean paint and well-kept tires hint at the car’s low mileage of just 21,888 miles.

This example was offered by Iconic Auctioneers at a live auction on 11th November 2023 at NEC Birmingham. Finished in Mallard Green with a cloth interior, it is one of the small-turbo variants producing 214 bhp. Accompanied by a comprehensive history file and a new MOT, the car remained unsold and awaits its next enthusiast owner.
